entries.title: Psalms 107:1
segments: ¶O give praise to the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 107:2
segments: Let those whose cause the Lord has taken up say so, his people whom he has taken out of the hands of their haters;

entries.title: Psalms 107:3
segments: Making them come together out of all the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.

entries.title: Psalms 107:4
segments: They were wandering in the waste places; they saw no way to a resting-place.

entries.title: Psalms 107:5
segments: Their souls became feeble for need of food and drink.

entries.title: Psalms 107:6
segments: Then they sent up their cry to the Lord in their sorrow, and he gave them salvation out of all their troubles;

entries.title: Psalms 107:7
segments: Guiding them in the right way, so that they might come into the town of their resting-place.

entries.title: Psalms 107:8
segments: Let men give praise to the Lord for his mercy, and for the wonders which he does for the children of men!

entries.title: Psalms 107:9
segments: He gives its desire to the unresting soul, so that it is full of good things.

entries.title: Psalms 107:10
segments: ¶Those who were in the dark, in the black night, in chains of sorrow and iron;

entries.title: Psalms 107:11
segments: Because they went against the words of God, and gave no thought to the laws of the Most High:

entries.title: Psalms 107:12
segments: So that he made their hearts weighted down with grief; they were falling, and had no helper.

entries.title: Psalms 107:13
segments: Then they sent up their cry to the Lord in their sorrow, and he gave them salvation out of all their troubles.

entries.title: Psalms 107:14
segments: He took them out of the dark and the black night, and all their chains were broken.

entries.title: Psalms 107:15
segments: Let men give praise to the Lord for his mercy, and for the wonders which he does for the children of men!

entries.title: Psalms 107:16
segments: The doors of brass are broken by his arm, and the bands of iron are cut in two.

entries.title: Psalms 107:17
segments: ¶Foolish men, because of their sins, and because of their wrongdoing, are troubled;

entries.title: Psalms 107:18
segments: They are disgusted by all food, and they come near to the doors of death.

entries.title: Psalms 107:19
segments: Then they send up their cry to the Lord in their sorrow, and he gives them salvation out of all their troubles.

entries.title: Psalms 107:20
segments: He sent his word and made them well, and kept them safe from the underworld.

entries.title: Psalms 107:21
segments: Let men give praise to the Lord for his mercy, and for the wonders which he does for the children of men!

entries.title: Psalms 107:22
segments: Let them make offerings of praise, giving news of his works with cries of joy.

entries.title: Psalms 107:23
segments: ¶Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in the great waters;

entries.title: Psalms 107:24
segments: They see the works of the Lord, and his wonders in the deep.

entries.title: Psalms 107:25
segments: For at his word comes up the storm-wind, lifting high the waves.

entries.title: Psalms 107:26
segments: The sailors go up to heaven, and down into the deep; their souls are wasted because of their trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 107:27
segments: They are turned here and there, rolling like a man who is full of wine; and all their wisdom comes to nothing.

entries.title: Psalms 107:28
segments: Then they send up their cry to the Lord in their sorrow, and he gives them salvation out of all their troubles.

entries.title: Psalms 107:29
segments: He makes the storm into a calm, so that the waves are at peace.

entries.title: Psalms 107:30
segments: Then they are glad, because the sea is quiet, and he takes them to the harbour of their desire.

entries.title: Psalms 107:31
segments: Let men give praise to the Lord for his mercy, and for the wonders which he does for the children of men!

entries.title: Psalms 107:32
segments: Let them give glory to him in the meeting of the people, and praise among the chiefs.

entries.title: Psalms 107:33
segments: ¶He makes rivers into waste places, and springs of water into a dry land;

entries.title: Psalms 107:34
segments: He makes a fertile country into a salt waste, because of the sins of those who are living there.

entries.title: Psalms 107:35
segments: He makes a waste land into a place of water, and a dry land into water-springs.

entries.title: Psalms 107:36
segments: And there he gives the poor a resting-place, so that they may make themselves a town;

entries.title: Psalms 107:37
segments: And put seed in the fields and make vine-gardens, to give them fruit.

entries.title: Psalms 107:38
segments: He gives them his blessing so that they are increased greatly, and their cattle do not become less.

entries.title: Psalms 107:39
segments: And when they are made low, and crushed by trouble and sorrow,

entries.title: Psalms 107:40
segments: He puts an end to the pride of kings, and sends them wandering in the waste lands where there is no way.

entries.title: Psalms 107:41
segments: But he puts the poor man on high from his troubles, and gives him families like a flock.

entries.title: Psalms 107:42
segments: The upright see it and are glad: the mouth of the sinner is stopped.

entries.title: Psalms 107:43
segments: Let the wise give thought to these things, and see the mercies of the Lord.
